execution.scope: Source-only l25 diagnostic, never the shared package build.
execution.recovery: The first process completed all four reference views, then exhausted its default 4 GiB heap while constructing the enlarged bar crop. A separate bounded 8 GiB process reused the completed views, replayed their exact Earth residuals and finished the same bar render. The model and calibration were unchanged.

acceptance.status: Completed l25 dust diagnostic. The visual lane criterion fails; l21 remains the accepted base.
acceptance.visualAssessment: The inspected close-up shows fewer black punctures than l24, but some remain beside bright gas. The bar remains predominantly beige, with neither the connected brown-orange lanes nor the blue-white intervals of the photo. Lane placement improves slightly, while lane color is effectively unchanged. Face-on, 45 degree and edge-on views remain coherent without an Earth-direction extrusion.
acceptance.impasse: The bounded dust-only trials do not reproduce the photo lanes. No further geometry, stellar-color or per-pixel corrections were introduced after the round cap.
rounds: A continuous disc-normal Gaussian layer removed random depths but washed out native filaments in projection. It was rejected at tiny size.
Fixed positive Gaussian depth quadrature keeps native filament positions and the adopted 250 pc width.

After correcting the source-aperture calculation, three tiny bar evaluations at global strengths 0.8, 1.0 and 1.2 select 1.2 by lane R/G and B/G errors while retaining whole-bar color within 2 percent. This is the final bounded calibration round.
acceptance.implementationCorrection: A provisional denominator used nearest-centre assignments instead of the full published OGLE measurement squares. That render was terminated. The denominator now uses all measured native dust samples in each complete square, with a behavior test and a caught removal check. Corrected tiny calibration and the final 512 px run supersede provisional results.
acceptance.chenRegionalCheck: Unavailable, by owner-approved exception. Only its published mean foreground E(B-V)=0.06 mag is used. The NADC login HTML is excluded.
